leadDecision.qualityClaim: No clean or normal-quality claim is made. Both channels were distorted/static-like in the source-separated listening clips.
leadDecision.residualRisk: Determine and remediate the distortion cause before Milestone 7 release acceptance; do not advertise normal recording quality from this evidence.
